
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/towerbit/p/19972565" title="发布于 2026-05-04 19:40">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">拿 DeepSeek 的免费对话搓了个 Everything 的静态 WebUI</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>过节有点时间捣鼓 Everything 的 HTTP 共享，发现对于自己家里用 Win10 NAS 来说，无论是按目录浏览还是快速查找，直接用 Evertything 的 Web 端都太顺手了。唯一不太满意的，就是这个自带的 WebUI 是为桌面浏览器设计的，在手机上用起来就不太舒服了。在网上找了一圈没找到现成的插件定制 UI，于是我突发奇想，索性就在 DeepSeek 免费的 Web Chat 里让它搓了一个 SearchUI.html 出来。<br>这个手搓的过程完全是在浏览器里通过：对话提出要求 -&gt;复制代码到文件-&gt;测试-&gt;对话提出改进要求 的方式完成的，我刻意没用平常习惯的 vscode + kilocode，就想比较一下有什么区别。</p>
<p>1. 每次测试修改，AI 都会重新生成完整的 html, 因为不是只修改部分代码，所以输出的速度显然比调用 API 要慢不少<br>2. 有一次改崩了目录显示的逻辑，然后我无论怎么提示都恢复不回去，最后只能把旧的版本文件拖给它，让在这个基础上修改才算翻过这个坎儿<br>3. 每次 AI 都会信誓旦旦地保证代码一定能正常工作，我开始还将信将疑，后面就完全无视了<br>4. 我本来是打算全程一点代码都不写的，但是现实是我发现有些关键点，我手动修改一下，远比跟 AI 啰嗦半天效率要高得多。吐糟给 AI 吧，得到的回复居然说这才是人机合作开发的最高境界？！&nbsp;</p>
<p>最终结果，花了半天时间，经历了大概四十多轮对话，终于完美实现了我所需要的，适应手机的UI效果，挂到 Everything 的 HTTP 服务下面（不是替代默认页面），完美。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>这是 Everything 自带的 HTTP 页面</p>
<p><img alt="图片" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/193271/202605/193271-20260504193429310-1524566041.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;这是我定制的页面</p>
<p><img alt="图片" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/193271/202605/193271-20260504194537116-498146431.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>这个静态页面本质上就是通过 JS 解析 Eveything 的 HTML，技术说穿了就不值钱，分享出来供有需要的网友参考。&nbsp;</p>

        }

        <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getDirectoryPath(fullPath) {

                        name </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name.split(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">\\</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).pop();
                    }
                    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">!</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">name) </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

                    const isFolder </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (size </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">===</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">''</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&amp;&amp;</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">!</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">^[A-Z]:$</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i.test(name));
                    let folderPath </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (isFolder) {
                        folderPath </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> urlToLocalPath(nativeUrl);
                    }

                    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取文件所在目录路径</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    const localPath </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> urlToLocalPath(nativeUrl);
                    const directoryPath </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isFolder </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">?</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> localPath : getDirectoryPath(localPath);

                    results.push({ name, nativeUrl, size, date, isFolder, folderPath, directoryPath });
                }
            }
            </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> results;
        }

                                    <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">div class</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">file-name</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">div&gt;</span>
                                    <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">div class</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">file-meta</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">${item.size} • ${item.date} • ${escapeHtml(currentPath)}</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">div&gt;</span>
                                <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">div&gt;</span>
                            <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">a&gt;</span>
                        <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">li&gt;</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    `;
            }).join(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)}
            </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ul&gt;</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        `;
            resultsContainer.innerHTML </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> html;

            document.querySelectorAll(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">#resultsContainer .file-item[data-type="parent"], #resultsContainer .file-item[data-type="folder"]</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).forEach(el </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                el.addEventListener(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">click</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, (e) </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const path </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> el.dataset.path;
                    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (path) browseDirectory(path);
                });
            });
        }

        window.browseDirectory </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> browseDirectory;

        init();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">body</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
